notes.title: Long Time No Post — Here's What’s New in Kidbash: Super Legend!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Sorry it's been way too long since our last update here. Honestly, we've been completely swamped—between working on the game, searching for a publisher, joining events, and handling all sorts of other behind-the-scenes stuff… it's been hectic!

But today, we finally have a proper update for you—and there's a lot to share.

[h1]First off… we won an award.[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739558/81b2be7f5a54e72dea87c7be9e12dca5de4f53bf.png[/img]
At the end of last year, Kidbash: Super Legend won the "Most Fun to Play" Award at Indie X 2024!
This is our very first major award, and we couldn’t be more proud. Indie X is an amazing event that highlights some of the best new indie games every year, so receiving this recognition was a huge honor for us.

[h1]We also got featured on Vice[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739558/13056db57a58140282149463ab7553f83cf4e913.png[/img][url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/if-capcom-wont-do-it-kidbash-super-legend-will-this-mega-man-inspired-roguelike-has-its-hooks-in-me-demo-impressions/]Vice[/url]
Yep—VICE did write-up about us! Always super exciting to be covered by a major media outlet like that. Thank you so much to everyone who's helped us get noticed.

[h1]Six One Indie Showcase + New Trailer.[/h1]
[previewyoutube=d3k_j165K44;full][/previewyoutube]
Just last week, we were part of the Six One Indie Showcase, a super cool online event that gives indie devs a spotlight outside of the big studio showcases.

We also dropped a brand new trailer there and guess what? IGN picked it up and reuploaded it too!
That was a wild moment for us.

[h1]Updated Gameplay Demo for Media & Partners.[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739558/22c5fc5616e1b66eb746b72bc18515a50f668f41.png[/img]
Last but not least, we’ve recently rolled out a major update to our gameplay demo! This version is currently only available to our media friends and partners who already have access via private keys.

Thank you so much for your support and feedback so far, it’s been incredibly valuable as we continue to improve and refine Kidbash: Super Legend.

We’re really excited about the new content and can’t wait to show more to everyone soon!

That’s the big update for now! We’ll be sharing more news and dev updates here more regularly from now on, thanks so much for your patience and support. And once again… sorry for going quiet for so long!

Until next time!

notes.title: Tokyo Game Show 2024 & Japanese Localization
notes.notes:
We're super excited to announce that we're heading to Tokyo Game Show at Makuhari Messe, Chiba! You can find us there from Thursday, September 26th to Sunday, September 29th. 🇯🇵

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739558/7fad9730ab41933cc695082495f8287184aa1454.png[/img]

And that's not all! We've been busy bees:

[b]Japanese Localization[/b]: We've updated our Steam page with Japanese localization, so our Japanese fans can check out all the details! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739558/5ed3cb2813e7315a40c119d196157e4601477650.png[/img]

[b]In-Game Language[/b]: We've also added Japanese language support to the game itself! So, you can choose to play in Japanese before you start your super legendary adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739558/e6f78b4681491ec95a7fadd0751e8c42d3cfa39f.png[/img]

That's all for now! If you're planning on attending Tokyo Game Show, be sure to say hi. We can't wait to see you there!

notes.title: Let's Start a Super Legendary Journey
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋

We're so excited to share our first post with you all. First off, we want to say a massive thank you to everyone who has been reaching out and supporting Kidbash: Super Legend! This week has been absolutely crazy for us.

Our Overview Trailer unexpectedly blew up, thanks to YouTube's algorithm, and has already been viewed over 43k times! We've also hit 1k followers, which is incredible for such a small team like us! And even better, our wishlist has surpassed 2000! Thank you so much to everyone who has added Kidbash: Super Legend to their wishlist. Your support means the world to us.

[previewyoutube=5cD5Cxb0MS4;full][/previewyoutube]

All of this has fueled our fire to finish Kidbash: Super Legend and get it into your hands.

And the busy week doesn't end there! Next week, from the 21st to the 23rd, we'll be at Gamescom 2024 in Cologne, Germany. We're really looking forward to connecting with industry professionals and showcasing our vertical demo, which we've been working on for the past few months. We're hoping to find a potential publisher for Kidbash: Super Legend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739558/201f974a7113ce693fe84ce61bb99b2de15acebe.png[/img]

And If you're attending Gamescom, make sure to stop by the Business Area and visit the "Game from Indonesia" booth! We'd love to meet you and might even have a little surprise!

That's all for now! Thanks for reading and see you around! 🙏

Authentic Remixes Team.
